title: Setting up overdraft protection for your Blue Account
summary: This document explains how to set up Overdraft Protection for your Blue Account by linking a funding source to cover transactions that would otherwise create a negative balance. It details a $12.50 fee per protection-triggered transfer and a $10 cashier’s check issuance fee for that funding method.
